desc: YHM's Keymod Picatinny Adapter allows you to mount Picatinny accessories to your keymod handguard. The Continuous Keymod Rail System or C.K.R.S. can be mounted end-to-end to create a continuous Picatinny rail. Made from 6061-T6 aluminum that is hardcoat anodized and feature stainless keymod screws and nuts.
